Assign cross-validation folds for calibration

Source: R/calibrate.R
calibration_folds.Rd

With fold_group = NULL, assigns clips within each site x species, reproducing the original fold assignment. For grouped folds, give one or more column names, e.g. "source_audio" for recordings or "night" for nights. Site is always part of the grouping key. All species and clips sharing that key go into the same fold; groups are shuffled and distributed among folds within site, balancing group counts rather than clip counts. Each site must have at least k_folds groups.

Usage

calibration_folds(validations, k_folds = 5, seed = 2026, fold_group = NULL)

Arguments

validations

Calibration data including site, species and any columns named in fold_group. Use read_validations(keep = ) to retain metadata from validation files.

k_folds

Integer number of folds, at least two.

seed

Seed of the assignment; the caller's random state is restored.

fold_group

Optional character vector of grouping columns. Do not include species, verdicts or confidence scores: these would split recordings or nights by species or by outcome. Group IDs must be nonmissing and nonempty. NULL keeps the original clip folds.

Value

Integer vector of fold numbers, in the input row order.

Details

Grouped folds evaluate new recordings or nights at known sites, not transfer to new sites. Unlike clip folds, they cannot guarantee that each species appears in each training and test set. A test fold with only one verdict has no AUC but still contributes probability scores.
